verdict.rationale: Statsig's own docs describe Session Replay for recording and playing back real user sessions, and mention options to apply privacy filters to on-screen content. Nothing in the evidence says sensitive inputs are masked by default; the filters are framed as options. Missing for 10: evidence that masking is on by default, detail on which input types are masked, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch recordings of real user sessions with sensitive input masked by default

citations.quote: Session Replay records users interacting with your website or product and lets you play back those sessions.
with options to apply privacy filters to on-screen content
